''See also: [[Monarchs Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Monarchs are the most powerful individuals in their world, serving as legendary figures that many mortals view as myths. They occupy a tier of power above [[Sages]] and [[Heralds]], possessing the ability to shatter fortresses with words, tear open spatial rifts, and exert immense [[Spiritual pressure|spiritual pressure]]. While they are capable of fighting [[Dreadgods]] to a standstill, they often maintain an equilibrium with these entities to avoid triggering a larger calamity. This balance is maintained by ensuring the number of Monarchs remains stable, as too many could disrupt the world's safety. Monarchs typically rule over vast territories or powerful clans, such as the [[Akura clan|Akura family]], [[House Shen]], or the [[The Eight-Man Empire|Eight-Man Empire]]. Their influence is so great that they can hear their names spoken from across the globe, and their presence can be felt through projections of their will. Some Monarchs, like [[Emriss Silentborn]], are more public and travel to assist humanity, while others remain isolated in palaces. They often hold grand tournaments for their students to identify future leaders and demonstrate strength. Despite their immense [[Authority|authority]], being a [[Monarch]] carries a heavy burden of responsibility for protecting civilization and managing the threats posed by non-human factions.}}

== Wintersteel ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Historically identified by their blue badges, the Monarchs are spirits who once scanned [[Yerin]]. These entities have recently made various unusual remarks regarding the [[Ninecloud team]], though they can become upset if their view is interrupted. As a prize for a victor, the Monarchs offer their collective attention, which possesses the power to restore a damaged individual. Furthermore, they are capable of reversing injuries by rewriting the fundamental principles of [[madra]].}}

== Reaper ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|The secrets of the Monarchs were offered to [[Lindon]] by [[Elder Whisper]], prompting questions regarding why these beings have not intervened concerning the anchor. While attacks from Monarchs or [[Dreadgods]] have carved ravines into the territory near [[Refuge]], [[Eithan]] claims his own machinations cause these powerful entities to tremble. The Monarchs benefit from the existing system and have threatened to punish the team should they enter [[labyrinth|the labyrinth]]. These beings can clash over advice and maintain control over the records of the [[Dreadgods]], who are destined to die only once the Monarchs are gone. Ultimately, the Monarchs are part of the scenes remade in the [[World of Night]], and [[Lindon]] intends to drag them along with him as he advances.}}

== Dreadgod ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|The Monarchs are a group of powerful beings whose very existence upsets the natural balance. They represent a looming threat to [[Lindon]], who anticipates their arrival while the [[Heralds]] note that they are not currently being observed. These entities sustain the [[Dreadgods]], leading to conspiracy theories that the two forces are working together. While some Monarchs struggle against the workings of the [[Silent King]], their prolonged presence causes a [[hunger aura]]. Because they allow the [[Dreadgods]] to persist, the [[Abidan]] classify the Monarchs as parasites.}}

== Waybound ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|As the kings and queens of the world, these powerful entities possess the strength to fight [[Dreadgods]] but require immense willpower to combat. They are known to cycle for years at a time and utilize time-warped pocket dimensions, even financing specific operations. During a mythic war, [[Lindon]] challenged the Monarchs, who were hit by [[black dragon's breath]] and sought to deny him time to prepare. While [[Yerin]] has previously faced them down, the Monarchs must ultimately be removed from the world, a goal supported by the [[soul-oath|soul oath]] designed to prevent their rise.}}
